brief.scope: Read ../in/draft65-repository-boundary.md WHOLE. Fix only monitor.py repository discovery: fixed HERE.parents[3] becomes '/' for a staged instrument and rejects every legal state directory. Use actual repository markers, including worktree .git files; absent marker is not a whole-filesystem boundary. Preserve actual checkout refusal, config/source separation, symlink/db restrictions and all other security fixes. NO tests or live stores/vendors. Owned staged-mode and checkout-refusal probes, Ruff/diff.

envelope.note: Implemented only monitor.py repository discovery. Assumption: an actual checkout marker is a .git directory containing HEAD or a bounded regular worktree .git file whose gitdir target contains HEAD. No tests, live stores, or vendors were used. The final owned verification command exited 0. Git commit was blocked by the read-only sandbox; the launcher commit message is in out/COMMIT_MSG.
